title: Moving to Los Angeles through his wife's family, and upcoming TV shows with Johnny Hartman
summary: Their daughter was born in California where Charlotte's parents lived; the transcript then turns to upcoming Iowa public TV shows, including one with Johnny Hartman.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Let's see. One other hole that I had in the other interview was, I never found out why you came out to the West Coast and lived in Los Angeles. There's some predictable logic, but do you want to talk about that, and how you acquired your home there that you live in now?
Well, to begin with, our daughter was born in California. And mainly because it was my wife's home. And her parents lived in Los Angeles.
We still do quite a bit of it, and early really, this coming season we'll be doing two more in Iowa.
Yes. One, I'm very proud to say, with Johnny Hartman, which I feel will be the best exposure he's had in a long time.
I think so. And one other, and that will be this a good season.
So what -- would it be a concert thing?
Yeah. One-hour shows. We're doing two of them.
It would be nice if you have got Johnny to sing with your band sometime, and tape it for a record. (Inaudible) I could just see it-- he's beautiful.

Yeah. Well, it was always one of my intentions, and we weren't able to put it together yet, but we will. And it's the same with many other projects I've thought of, finding record people to (inaudible) do it is very difficult.
